speaker: Mara
quote: Before you carry another part of me out of this room, tell me what happened to the first one.
text: Before you carry another part of me out of this room, tell me what happened to the first one.

speaker: Mara
quote: He paid you for it. I thought hearing you say it would feel different.
text: He paid you for it. I thought hearing you say it would feel different.

speaker: Mara
quote: So it went to him and to the street. When do I get to be more than the voice they pass around?
text: So it went to him and to the street. When do I get to be more than the voice they pass around?

speaker: Mara
quote: I never asked you to choose what was worth keeping. I know why you might have.
text: I never asked you to choose what was worth keeping. I know why you might have.

speaker: Mara
quote: He paid for what was left. I wonder which part of me he thought was the useful part.
text: He paid for what was left. I wonder which part of me he thought was the useful part.

speaker: Mara
quote: You came back without it. That doesn't tell me what was left in the chair.
text: You came back without it. That doesn't tell me what was left in the chair.

speaker: Mara
quote: You stayed in that sentence. Thank you. It is harder to talk to someone who keeps disappearing behind the job.
text: You stayed in that sentence. Thank you. It is harder to talk to someone who keeps disappearing behind the job.

speaker: Mara
quote: Quill is not sitting here. You are. We can finish the letter. Leave the rest for today.
text: Quill is not sitting here. You are. We can finish the letter. Leave the rest for today.

speaker: Mara
quote: Then carry only what we agreed. You don't owe me your reasons, and I don't owe you a softer version of mine.
text: Then carry only what we agreed. You don't owe me your reasons, and I don't owe you a softer version of mine.

speaker: Mara
quote: I remember where you put yourself in the story. You can sit without explaining it again.
text: I remember where you put yourself in the story. You can sit without explaining it again.

speaker: Mara
quote: Last time, you told me whose job it was. You never told me where you stood.
text: Last time, you told me whose job it was. You never told me where you stood.

speaker: Mara
quote: We left that conversation where we meant to. I haven't filled the silence in for you.
text: We left that conversation where we meant to. I haven't filled the silence in for you.

speaker: Mara
quote: You told me where the hour went. We stopped before the rest. We can leave it there.
text: You told me where the hour went. We stopped before the rest. We can leave it there.

speaker: Mara
quote: A morning market. I used to go before the stalls opened, when nobody wanted anything from me yet. I would like to choose that again.

speaker: Mara
quote: I hear the difference. Let it stay different. I don't want to do the rest of this conversation today.
